name: What is involved in designing and installing a custom patio with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in designing and installing a custom patio with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Designing and installing a custom patio with AKN Design Group involves a comprehensive, managed process. We begin with a consultation to understand your vision, lifestyle needs, and how you intend to use the space for relaxation or entertaining. Our team then develops CAD-supported layouts and material selections, considering elements like covered structures, hardscaping, outdoor kitchens, and fire features. The process includes permit coordination, construction, and final walkthrough, ensuring seamless integration with your home. Our integrated design-build approach means you work with a single, accountable team from concept to completion, avoiding the complexities of managing multiple contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group's custom patio process includes consultation, CAD-supported design, material selection, permit coordination, construction, and a final walkthrough, all managed by a single team.
